rules.title: EU REACH SVHC Candidate List (updated about twice a year)
rules.date_label: List had 253 entries after Feb 2026 update
rules.summary: Each addition can trigger customer-notification duties for products containing the substance above 0.1% by weight of an article.
rules.why_it_matters: Every BOM part needs substance data from its supplier; a new listing means re-checking parts.
rules.workaround: Keep supplier substance declarations current per part.

rules.title: UFLPA Entity List (U.S. forced-labor import ban)
rules.summary: Goods made with forced labor in Xinjiang, or by listed entities, are presumed barred from import. DHS keeps adding companies to the list.
rules.why_it_matters: A supplier appearing on the list blocks imports of its parts; you need tier-below visibility.
rules.source: DHS UFLPA Entity List (updates summarized by SiliconExpert)
rules.workaround: Screen suppliers and their sub-tier sources against each update.

rules.title: Section 232 tariffs on semiconductors
rules.summary: Semiconductor imports face Section 232 duties, per recent summaries.
rules.why_it_matters: Chips and modules on your BOM from abroad cost more.
rules.workaround: Check HTS codes and country of origin per part.
